# Assets

`banner.png` and `social.png` go here.

Both are made per repository, never from a template: screenshot the target to understand its visual
world, write a prose description naming the scene, the palette, the concrete real-world subject, and
the exact text strings, then hand that description to the image model. The model renders the type.
Iterate on the words, not on the files.

No layout script, no compositing, no text pasted on afterwards. If a layout script reappears in this
folder, delete it.
